scope: Local only. No runtime, physics, geometry, lighting/weather, scenery/mission, car, remote, main or staging edits. All original generated images, previous sources in Git, and QA retained.

qaMeasurementRepair.cause: Both cars crossed circuit distance zero; old final-minus-initial computation falsely reported negative progress despite live on-road movement. No startup error, missing art or page/network errors in original snapshots.
qaMeasurementRepair.change: Signed per-sample circuit unwrap with unchanged 20m threshold, normal inputs, 90s movement and production loading deadlines; rejects projection jumps, world teleports and reversed clocks.
qaMeasurementRepair.status: Two corrected regional runs passed; original failed measurements retained, not relabeled.

regionalDriving.scope: Short real-travel and driving samples only. Inspect retained authored frames separately; no route-wide or visual acceptance inferred.

nightProductionReview.interpretation: Authored .05 sky is effectively black behind headlight-lit road. Diagnostic sky100 has restrained blue-black horizon that fits the dark foreground, but this does not grant authored horizon readability or change release exposure.

finalDriving.scope: Short real-travel and driving samples only. Inspect retained authored frames separately; no route-wide or visual acceptance inferred.
